LESSON: WRITING 1.3.1 SOCIAL WRITING - SMS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: when writing an SMS, • use SMS observing etiquette. How do we ensure etiquette when using digital devices?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify features of a Short Message Service (SMS) for information
2. create an SMS text with appropriate features for effective communication

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS

Teach
• Focus skill: identify features of a Short Message Service (SMS) for information.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. when writing an SMS, • use SMS observing etiquette. How do we ensure etiquette when using digital devices?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
